facts.fact: Republic Online reports that the NIA provides biometric verification services of the national ID that institutions use daily, and that commercial banks pay for continuous access to verify customers.
The NIA chief says GRA, NHIS, the Passport Office and commercial banks all use NIA biometric verification, with the first three owing $457 million for it.

systems.platform: Margins ID Group identity management system under PPP

GHA.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
Only the contract target of 89 million cards is given, no count of people enrolled.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The document says the partner provides maintenance and card production while NIA owns data and infrastructure, which fits no stated rung.

facts.fact: Republic Online reports that GRA revenue collection and NHIS member verification depend on NIA biometric verification, with GRA owing $377 million and NHIS $58 million for it.

Republic Online reports that the National Identification System is in operation under a 15-year PPP contract with Margins ID Group for Ghana Cards and biometric verification, and that NIA staff speak of fingerprint verification.
